{{Quote|The Republic won't be able to prove a thing. We'll tell them it was Sisar pirates.|[[Narvusin]]|<ref name="TOR:StP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Shattering the Peace|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The '''Sisar pirates''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:StP" />
